response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS acl_igm FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(acl_igm) AS mean_igm FROM patient_averages), deviations AS (SELECT pa.ID, pa.SEX, pa.acl_igm, pa.acl_igm - om.mean_igm AS deviation FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS mean_deviation FROM deviations GROUP BY SEX), results AS (SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.acl_igm, d.deviation, d.deviation - s.mean_deviation AS excess FROM deviations AS d JOIN sex_averages AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.deviation > s.mean_deviation) SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, deviation, excess FROM results ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST, ID LIMIT 10;
